Shaabty made some Leather Trousers for me.
Lilit Island, Indoors.

suspected of working with S.A.R.A.H.

quest.text: Raify really hates Pious and asked me to help him.
He asked me to help him exterminate several pious and will reward me if I bring back proof of my deed.

Raify needs: 50 Forest Piou Feathers and 50 Mana Piou Feathers as proof.

quest.text: Sponsors have access to special, monthly quests.
These quests allow to sell some items to NPC
(eg. 7 black scorpion stingers) for normal sell price.

Strange Coins can also be obtained at daily login, events, and gift boxes.
It's not a premium currency. You cannot buy Strange Coins.
